explanation:
# Place and route summary - alu8

All numbers are quoted from `reports/pnr_iterations.json`, `reports/cts_report.json` and `reports/floorplan_report.json`. Nothing here is a new measurement; the S2S runtime runs the real checks.

## Plan
Read the single recorded P&R iteration, tabulate its parameters and results, cross-check with the floorplan and CTS reports, and list what the data does not cover.

## Iteration table
Only one iteration was run. It reported no problems, so no parameters were changed.

| Iteration | Tag | FP_CORE_UTIL | PL_TARGET_DENSITY_PCT | MAX_FANOUT_CONSTRAINT | Problems | Changes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | it1 | 40 | 55.0 | 10 | none (`problems: []`) | none (`changes: []`) |

Iteration budget used: 1 of 8 (default).

## Final state (iteration 1)

### Routing, DRC, antenna, connectivity
| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| Route DRC errors | 0 |
| Antenna violating nets | 0 |
| Antenna violating pins | 0 |
| Disconnected pins | 0 |
| Max slew violations | 0 |
| Max cap violations | 0 |
| Max fanout violations | 0 |
| Wirelength | 5485 um |
| Utilization (post-P&R) | 0.460397 |

### Congestion
The input data contains no congestion or routing-overflow figure (no GRT overflow or congestion map numbers). Congestion is therefore **not reported** here. Indirect signals only: 0 route DRC errors and 0 disconnected pins after routing.

### Floorplan context
- Die area 7368.13 um^2, core area 4723.28 um^2.
- Floorplan utilization 0.428079 (chosen core utilization 40%); post-P&R utilization 0.460397 (rises after CTS, hold and repair buffers are added).
- Power grid violations: 0.
- Pins: 33. Inputs a[7:0], b[7:0], op[2:0] on West; outputs result[7:0], flag_z/c/v/n on East; clk on North; rst_n on South.

### Clock tree
- Worst tree skew 0.0 ns against a 1.3333 ns target (`cts_worst_tree_skew_ns`, `cts_target_ns`); 9 corners with skew data.
- Clock buffers 3, hold buffers 8, timing-repair buffers 53.
- Clock source latency ranges from 0.159133 ns (min_ff_n40C_1v95) to 0.411331 ns (max_ss_100C_1v60).

### Timing (worst slack per corner, ns, from iteration 1 facts)
Positive slack means the check is met at that corner. Clock period 13.333 ns (75 MHz, REQ-014).

| Corner | Setup worst slack | Hold worst slack |
|---|---|---|
| nom_tt_025C_1v80 | 6.229007264078433 | 0.7754375139263605 |
| nom_ss_100C_1v60 | 3.355372963337437 | 1.832508308076684 |
| nom_ff_n40C_1v95 | 7.3135326531588785 | 0.4211170698016109 |
| min_tt_025C_1v80 | 6.261385365195107 | 0.7737877224651082 |
| min_ss_100C_1v60 | 3.4176218378210583 | 1.8302440081539222 |
| min_ff_n40C_1v95 | 7.338188486787069 | 0.4195979793496291 |
| max_tt_025C_1v80 | 6.191840104787293 | 0.7787062881590603 |
| max_ss_100C_1v60 | 3.2760435291814916 | 1.8379696063115736 |
| max_ff_n40C_1v95 | 7.282238573834108 | 0.4233489789667132 |

- Tightest setup: max_ss_100C_1v60 at 3.2760435291814916 ns.
- Tightest hold: min_ff_n40C_1v95 at 0.4195979793496291 ns.
- Typical corner (REQ-014 sign-off corner): nom_tt_025C_1v80 setup 6.229007264078433 ns, hold 0.7754375139263605 ns.
- All 18 setup/hold values in the data are positive. Sign-off still depends on the runtime's post-route STA run (Chronos), not on this summary.

## Limits of this data
- No congestion/overflow numbers are given.
- Only one iteration exists, so there is no before/after comparison of parameter changes.
- The 53 timing-repair buffers are large for a 12-flop design (REQ-016); the cause is not identified in the data.
assumptions: setup_ws_by_corner / hold_ws_by_corner in pnr_iterations.json are post-route worst slacks in ns (positive = met); the file does not label the stage explicitly.
Iteration 1 is the final state, since pnr_iterations.json holds only one entry.
Default iteration budget of 8 applies; only 1 was used.
The rise in utilization from 0.428079 (floorplan) to 0.460397 (P&R facts) is attributed to buffers added by CTS, hold fixing and repair; the data does not break this down.
open_issues: No congestion or global-routing overflow numbers are present in the input data; congestion cannot be reported. The runtime should supply the GRT overflow/congestion report if it is required.
53 timing-repair buffers is large for a 12-flop design; the driver (e.g. 0 ns I/O delay assumption, slew/cap repair) is not identified in the data. Chronos/Orion should confirm.
Tightest hold slack is 0.4195979793496291 ns at min_ff_n40C_1v95; sign-off post-route STA (REQ-014) must be confirmed by the real STA run.
